versions.changelog:
- No user-visible changes in this release.
- Version number updated only; no changes detected to source files or documentation.

- Initial release with full support for translating PDF, DOCX, and PPTX files via the Bluente Translation API.
- Step-by-step guided user input collection (API key, source files, target language, output location) with clear options and support for custom entries.
- Automatic lookup and validation of target language codes using built-in mapping and API fallback.
- Reliable batch translation workflow handled by an all-in-one Python script.
- Automatic detection of single files or folders containing multiple supported document types.
- Clear summary reporting on translation results, including file save locations and any errors.
